name: Eyes of the Eagle

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight; you can see clearly a mile away.
text: Wearing these crystal lenses gives you Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks based on sight. When visibility is clear, you can discern fine detail on any creature or object 2 feet across or larger, however far off it is.
